name: Qt 6 Widgets Application
description: A Qt 6 desktop window written in code (no .ui files) with qmake or CMake, plus compile and run scripts. QODE reads the project for clangd, so completion works from the start.

options.label: Build system
options.hint: qmake is what QODE itself uses. compile.sh and run.sh work with either.

options.label: Add a Qt resource file
options.hint: resources/app.qrc embeds the window icon in the program.

options.label: Use ccache when installed
options.hint: ccache remembers what the compiler produced, so rebuilding code that did not change is nearly instant. Skipped automatically if ccache is not installed.

options.label: Use mold linker when installed
options.hint: mold is a very fast drop-in replacement for the system linker. Qt programs link many libraries, so it helps noticeably. Skipped automatically if mold is not installed.

options.label: Add a .clang-format file
options.hint: Format Document uses it (LLVM style, 4 spaces).
